messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?

hey there - i was just thinking about your background and what you're looking for next

what's the dream role you've been thinking about?
Jijil
jijil... that's got some character to it. where you working these days?
In Accenture as a associate manager.

accenture... the consulting giant that everyone loves to hate but somehow keeps growing. associate manager sounds like you've climbed a bit from the trenches.

found you on linkedin - jijil kakkadathu at accenture. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/jijilk
Yes.

application development at accenture... you've been building systems while everyone else just talks about digital transformation. that's real work right there.

what made you get into the development side instead of pure consulting? most people at accenture end up in meetings about meetings
Haha.

lol fair enough, some questions hit too close to home

alright let's get to business - how long you been working total?
15 years

15 years... that's serious experience. you've seen the industry evolve from whatever mess it was in 2009 to today's mess.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Architect roles.
Yes.

architect roles... makes sense with 15 years under your belt. time to stop building and start designing the blueprint.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Banglore and remote.
15 years experience + architect roles + bangalore/remote... sound right?

yooo jijil! you're officially in the tal ecosystem now 

15 years of grinding at accenture to architect level - that's some serious patience and skill. most people would've bounced after year 3.

here's what happens next: i'll start sliding architect roles that actually matter. not the "senior developer with fancy title" nonsense, but real system design, platform architecture, the stuff that makes ctos nervous when you're not around.

keep your notifications on. when the right role drops, you'll know.

welcome to the squad legend 🔥
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
